info.title: Quadratic Developer API
info.description:
Token-authenticated REST API for Quadratic spreadsheets. All `/v1/*` routes require an `Authorization: Bearer <token>` header where the token is a `qdx_live_…` or `qdx_test_…` value minted from the Quadratic UI.

**Optional `Quadratic-Session-Id` header.** Clients may attach a UUID v4 to every request to correlate analytics events from a single integration run (one client instance, one CLI invocation, one CI job). Official SDKs generate one at construction and send it transparently; direct callers may omit it. Malformed values are dropped silently and never propagated to analytics.

get.summary:
Serves the raw OpenAPI 3.1 spec for the developer API. The same spec
is rendered as interactive HTML at `/docs`.
Lists the caller's team's ready agent connections.

parameters.name: team_uuid
parameters.description:
Team UUID that owns the connections. Defaults to the caller's
token-scoped team when omitted.

200.description: Ready agent connections for the team

404.description: Team not found or not visible to the caller

get.summary:
Fetches a single agent connection by UUID, including its full plan and
apiSchema.

parameters.name: team_uuid
parameters.description:
Team UUID that owns the connections. Defaults to the caller's
token-scoped team when omitted.

404.description: Connection or team not found / not visible to the caller

get.summary:
Returns identity information derived from the API token that authorized
this request. Useful for verifying a token works and discovering which
team it belongs to.

401.description: Missing, malformed, or invalid bearer token

post.summary:
Fetches DB schemas from the connection service. Unlike the other
endpoints this doesn't require a worker — it talks directly to the
`quadratic-connection` service.
post.description:
The response is an array — one entry per requested `connection_id` —
of either `{ connection_id, schema }` (success) or
`{ connection_id, error }` (per-connection failure). The HTTP status
is `200` even when individual connections fail.

get.summary: Lists files visible to the caller across every team they belong to.

post.summary:
Creates a new blank file. If `team_uuid` is omitted the file is created
in the team the caller's API token is scoped to.

REST-only convenience endpoint that creates a new blank file and imports
the given bytes into it in a single request.

get.summary: Fetches metadata for a single file by UUID.

404.description: File not found or not visible to the caller

post.summary:
Executes a batch of actions sequentially, stopping on the first error.
Mirrors the MCP `batch` semantics. The response is an array of
`{action, result}` objects up to and including the failed action.

get.summary:
Reads cell values for a selection. Read-only; dispatches via
`/mcp/query`.

parameters.name: sheet_name
parameters.description: Optional sheet name. Defaults to the active sheet when omitted.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Zero-indexed page when the selection is paginated by the worker.

put.summary: Writes a 2D block of values starting at `top_left_position`.

delete.summary: Deletes the contents of every cell in the selection.

get.summary: Fetches the source and computed value of a single code cell.

404.description: No code cell at that position

put.summary: Creates or updates a Python / JavaScript / Formula code cell.

200.description: Code cell updated; worker may include compute results

post.summary: Triggers re-execution of code cells in the file (or selection).

get.summary:
Lists the formula / code-cell dependencies that flow into or out of
the given position.
Reads cell formatting (font, color, alignment, etc.) for a selection.

put.summary: Applies formatting to one or more cells in a single batch.
Writes one or more formula cells in a single batch.

get.summary: Returns whether any cell in the selection contains data.

post.summary: Merges every cell in the selection into a single visual cell.

delete.summary: Splits previously-merged cells back into individual cells.

post.summary: Moves a rectangular block of cells to a new location.

put.summary: Creates or updates a SQL code cell backed by a registered connection.

post.summary: Inserts one or more columns at the given position.

delete.summary: Deletes the named columns from the sheet.

put.summary:
Sets the default width for columns that haven't been individually
resized.
Resizes one or more columns to the given pixel width.

get.summary: Returns all conditional-format rules on a single sheet.

put.summary:
Creates, updates, or deletes conditional-format rules on a sheet.
Rules with `action: "delete"` only require the `id` field; `create` and
`update` rules need a `selection` plus a formula (`rule`) or a
`color_scale_thresholds` array.

get.summary:
Returns a worker-built context blob (summary of sheets, tables, named
ranges, etc.) suitable for feeding to LLMs.

parameters.name: sheet_name
parameters.description: Optional sheet to scope the context to.

parameters.name: include_errors
parameters.description: Include code-cell errors in the context payload. Defaults to `false`.

get.summary: Reads a tabular slice of cell data, optimized for bulk consumption.

parameters.name: max_rows
parameters.description: Caps the number of rows returned. Omit for the worker default.

post.summary:
Imports bytes into an existing file. The file is updated in place; the
response is the worker's import summary.

get.summary:
Returns a structural outline of the file: sheets, named ranges,
tables, and code cells.

post.summary: Re-applies the last `count` operations that were undone.
Inserts one or more rows at the given position.

delete.summary: Deletes the listed rows from the sheet.

put.summary: Sets the default height for rows that haven't been individually resized.
Resizes one or more rows to the given pixel height.

get.summary: Searches cell values (and optionally code-cell source) for matches.

parameters.name: whole_cell
parameters.description: Only match when the query covers the entire cell value.

get.summary:
Returns info for all sheets, or a single sheet when `sheet_name` is
provided. Read-only; dispatches via the worker's `/mcp/query` route.

parameters.name: sheet_name
parameters.description:
Limit the response to a single sheet by name. Omit to list every
sheet in the file.

post.summary: Adds a new sheet to the file.

patch.summary: Recolors one or more sheet tabs in a single call.

post.summary: Duplicates an existing sheet under a new name.

delete.summary:
Deletes a sheet by name. Files must always have at least one sheet, so
the worker will reject deleting the last remaining sheet.

patch.summary:
Sets the frozen (pinned) rows and columns for a sheet. Frozen rows always
start at row 1 and frozen columns always start at column 1.

post.summary: Creates a new data table on the given sheet.

patch.summary:
Updates table-level metadata (name, header visibility, alternating
row colors, etc.). Only the fields you supply are changed.

put.summary: Updates per-column settings (display name, sort, filter) on a table.

post.summary: Converts a plain range of cells into a structured data table.
Reverts the last `count` operations on a file.

get.summary: Lists all data-validation rules on a file (or one sheet).

parameters.name: sheet_name
parameters.description: Optional sheet to filter by. Omit to list across the whole file.

delete.summary: Removes any data-validation rule(s) covering the given selection.

post.summary:
Adds a list-of-values validation. Either `list_source_list` or
`list_source_selection` must be supplied (but not both).

400.description: Missing list source or other validation error

post.summary: Adds a boolean (true/false) validation rule to a selection.

drop_down.description: Render a dropdown chooser inside the cell.

list_source_list.description:
Inline list of allowed values. Mutually exclusive with
`list_source_selection`.

list_source_selection.description:
A1 range whose values become the allowed list. Mutually exclusive
with `list_source_list`.

selection.description: A1 range the rule applies to.

show_checkbox.description: Render the cell as a checkbox when `true`.

insert_before_sheet_name.description:
If set, insert the new sheet immediately before the named sheet.
Otherwise append at the end.

table_data.description: 2D array — first row is treated as column names.

top_left_position.description: A1 anchor for the new table's top-left.

AgentConnectionDetail.description:
Detail returned by `GET /v1/agent-connections/{connection_id}`. Includes
the full plan and apiSchema (resolved from the catalog for catalog-backed
connections whose row carries none).

api_schema.description: AI-generated apiSchema describing the API's resources / endpoints.

plan.description: Full AgentConnectionPlan JSON (auth pattern, base URL, endpoints, etc.).

secrets.description: `{{SECRET_NAME}}` references to use in fetch code.

AgentConnectionSecretBinding.description: One `{{SECRET_NAME}}` binding exposed by a connection.

secrets.description: `{{SECRET_NAME}}` references to use in fetch code.

action.description:
Action name; matches the worker tool names exposed by individual
REST endpoints (e.g. `set_cell_values`, `add_sheet`).

params.description:
Action params object — same shape as the corresponding REST
endpoint's request body.

actions.description: Ordered list of actions to execute. Stops at the first failure.

team_uuid.description:
Optional team UUID. If omitted we default to the team the caller's
API token is scoped to.

ErrorBody.description: Canonical error envelope returned by every non-2xx response.

code.description:
Stable machine-readable error code. Clients should switch on this
rather than parsing the human-readable `message`. See the README's
"Errors" section for the full list of codes.

details.description:
Optional structured context for the error (validation paths, worker
upstream messages, etc.). Absent when no extra context is available.

message.description:
Human-readable description of the failure. Suitable for logs but not
guaranteed to be stable across versions.

connection_ids.description: Connection UUIDs to fetch schemas for, in order.

connection_type.description:
Connection kind: `postgres`, `mysql`, `mssql`, `snowflake`, etc.
Must match the kind registered for these connections.

team_uuid.description: Team UUID that owns the connections.

HealthResponse.description:
Liveness probe response. Exposes the running version so deploys can be
confirmed without checking the binary directly.

status.description:
Always `"ok"` when the process is reachable. Use HTTP status to
detect failure rather than parsing this field.

version.description: `Cargo.toml` package version of the running binary.

file_data.description:
Base64-encoded bytes of the file being imported. Supported
extensions: `csv`, `xlsx`, `xls`, `parquet`, `parq`, `pqt`.

file_name.description:
Original filename, including its extension. The extension determines
the parser to use, so it must be present and one of the supported
formats below.

insert_at.description: Optional A1 cell reference for where to place the imported data.

file_data.description:
Base64-encoded bytes of the source file. Supported extensions:
`csv`, `xlsx`, `xls`, `parquet`, `parq`, `pqt`.

file_name.description:
Display name for the new Quadratic file. This is distinct from the
`file_data`'s original filename — e.g. you might upload `sales.csv`
but name the Quadratic file `"2025 Sales Report"`. Must include an
extension matching the source file format (`csv`, `xlsx`, `xls`,
`parquet`, `parq`, `pqt`); the extension drives which parser is used.

team_uuid.description: Optional team UUID — defaults to the caller's token-scoped team.

import.description: Worker-side import summary (raw passthrough from the worker).

column.description: Column letter (e.g. `A`, `BD`) the insert is anchored at.

right.description:
`true` to insert immediately to the right of `column`, `false` for
to the left.

below.description: `true` to insert immediately below `row`, `false` to insert above.

row.description: 1-indexed row number the insert is anchored at.

MeResponse.description: Identity of the caller derived from their API token.

authenticated.description:
Always `true` for a successful response (the request reached the
handler, which means bearer auth passed).

email.description: Email address associated with the user that owns the API token.

team_uuid.description:
UUID of the team the caller's token is scoped to. Handlers default to
this team when one isn't specified in the request.

token_uuid.description:
UUID of the API token authorizing this request. Useful for clients
that want to correlate their requests to tokens in audit logs.

source_selection_rect.description: A1-style rectangle to move from, e.g. `A1:B10`.

target_top_left_position.description: A1-style cell to anchor the moved block at.

insert_before_sheet_name.description:
If set, move the sheet to immediately before the named sheet.
Otherwise move to the end.

selection.description: Optional A1 selection to limit which code cells are re-run.

borders.description:
Array of border updates. Each entry is `{ sheet_name?, selection,
color?, border_type? }`. `border_type` defaults to `"all"` when
omitted and accepts: `top`, `bottom`, `left`, `right`, `outer`,
`inner`, `horizontal`, `vertical`, `all`, `clear`. `color` accepts
hex (`#RRGGBB`/`#RGB`), `rgb(...)`, or CSS named colors and defaults
to black.

top_left_position.description: A1-style top-left anchor for the array, e.g. `A1`.

formats.description:
Array of format updates. Each entry is `{ sheet_name?, selection,
bold?, italic?, underline?, strike_through?, text_color?, fill_color?,
align?, vertical_align?, wrap?, numeric_commas?, number_type?,
currency_symbol?, date_time?, font_size? }`. Colors accept hex
(`#RRGGBB`/`#RGB`), `rgb(...)`, or CSS named colors.

formulas.description:
Array of `{ position, formula }` (or richer) entries; the worker
validates the inner shape.

frozen_column_count.description: Number of columns to freeze (pin) starting at column 1. Use 0 to unfreeze columns.

frozen_row_count.description: Number of rows to freeze (pin) starting at row 1. Use 0 to unfreeze rows.

connection_id.description: UUID of the connection in the connection service.

column_names.description:
Per-column rename / visibility settings. Each item accepts either
`{old_name, new_name, show}` (AI-tool shape) or `{name, display_name,
show?}` (REST-friendly shape). `show` defaults to `true` if omitted.

table_location.description: A1 cell inside the target table.
A1 cell inside the target table (any cell within its range).

count.description: Number of operations to undo or redo. Defaults to `1`.

rules.description:
Conditional-format rules to create / update / delete. Each rule is
`{ action: "create" | "update" | "delete", id?, type: "formula" |
"color_scale", selection?, rule?, bold?, italic?, fill_color?, ... }`.
`id` is required for `update`/`delete`. `selection` and either `rule`
(for formula) or `color_scale_thresholds` (for color_scale) are
required for `create`/`update`.

bearer_auth.description: API tokens are minted from the Quadratic UI under Team Settings → API Tokens. Send as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.
